dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hi! I'm Kenji. I'm a new student from Japan.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ! aɪm ˈkɛndʒi. aɪm ə ˈnuː ˈstuːdənt frəm dʒəˈpæn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Welcome! I'm Nam. Where do you study in Japan?
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛlkəm! aɪm ˈnɑːm. ˈwɛr duː juː ˈstʌdi ɪn dʒəˈpæn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I study English. The engineering building is over there.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈstʌdi ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ. ði ˌɛndʒɪˈnɪrɪŋ ˌbɪldɪŋ ɪz ˌoʊvər ˈðɛr.
